title: Coast Guard, good Samaritans rescue 5 people from sinking vessel near Siletz Bay, Ore.
description: A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Air Station Astoria hoists four of five people from the water and a nearby vessel 27-miles west of Siletz Bay, Ore., Aug. 9, 2104, before transporting them to emergency medical personnel nearby following the capsizing of their 31-foot vessel. A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station North Bend hoisted the fifth person from a nearby vessel after they were rescued by good Samaritans. U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Astoria.
keywords: Air Station North Bend, Air Station Astoria, First Responder News, Selitz Bay, coast guad rescue, Coast Guard, search and rescue, Oregon
